entities.name: Mohamed Ibn Abdelkabir al-Kettani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muḥammad Bin ʿAbd al-Kabīr Al-Kattani, also known by his kunya Abū l-Fayḍ or simply as Muhammad Al-Kattani, was a Moroccan Sufi faqih, reformer and poet from Fes. He is recognised as the father of the Moroccan constitution movement and the leader of the Conditioned Bay'ah of 1908. He was also vocally opposed to the metastasizing French colonial presence in Morocco, and launched at-Tā'ūn, the first national newspaper in Morocco. He was a member of the al-Kattani family and the Tariqa Kattania, a Sufi order.
